recipe.visualDefinition: A central human figure reclining in a void of cosmic textures, featuring iridescent body paint that blends into a background of dark, crystalline nebula clouds. The scene is characterized by horizontal motion blur streaks, digital noise, and a vertical axis of minimalist typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject integrated into environment via shared color palette and texture
Vertical text axis bisecting the horizontal motion blur
High-contrast lighting between dark cosmic void and luminous skin highlights
Juxtaposition of organic human form against sharp digital glitch artifacts
coreInvariants: Deep indigo and magenta color base
Crystalline/glitter texture on skin and background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body figure centered vertically, slightly angled, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bright light source near the hip area.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye follows the vertical text line down the center, then radiates outward along the horizontal light streaks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense, textured negative space filled with cosmic dust and digital artifacts.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Magenta and Cyan (Nebula highlights and chromatic aberration)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Gold/Yellow (Central light source on body)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in highlights against extremely low-value, dark backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid flat blacks; use textured dark blues
Limit greens to subtle chromatic fringes

letterConstructionRules: Vertical orientation with characters rotated 90 degrees or stacked

composition.relationshipToImage: Acts as a spine for the composition

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all elements to maintain minimalist sci-fi aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Geometric purity matches the sci-fi theme.
Modern, clean, and legible at small scales.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution cosmic scene with a reclining figure covered in iridescent glitter body paint. Incorporate heavy horizontal motion blur, digital glitch streaks, and a color palette of deep indigo, magenta, and cyan. Add a bright lens flare near the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a single vertical column of uppercase geometric sans-serif text down the center of the image. Use white color, light weight, and extreme vertical tracking so the text spans the height of the figure.

verificationChecks: Is the text perfectly centered vertically?
Do the horizontal glitch lines intersect the subject naturally?
Is the iridescent texture visible on both the skin and the background?

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of subject and background
avoid: Muddy colors in the dark areas

postGenerationChecks: Check for chromatic aberration on edges
Ensure text legibility against busy background
Verify the 'glow' effect on the central light source
Confirm horizontal streaks are perfectly parallel
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Cosmic/Nebula Background] + [Glitter Body Paint Subject] + [Horizontal Glitch/Motion Blur] + [Vertical Geometric Typography].
